name: hardtech-cad
description: Hardtech-CAD: the HardTech area's CAD and simulation app behind the SuperApp's Cloud > Lnktree row. Three sections on the shared bottom nav: Models (MCAD and BIM, their folders of the HardTech-Stack-CAD-Simulators repository, the address read at build time from the SuperApp's declarations, and SolidWorks, planned, greyed), Home (an overview that opens every page) and Sim2Real (SAP2000, MATLAB and Ansys, planned pages that describe how each tool is meant to connect).

signing._doc: ONE shared Cloud-constellation signing key for ALL Android apps. KEY LOCATION: Shared/Providers/D_TOOLS-DEVICES/d2-android/release.jks (OU=Cloud Constellation) + Shared/Providers/D_TOOLS-DEVICES/d2-android/signing.secrets.yaml.

auto_update._doc_max_installs_per_pass: Most install sessions ONE unattended background pass may open. A background pass cannot show the system install dialog (Android 10+ blocks background activity starts), so each install it starts leaves a tap-to-install notification holding a PackageInstaller session until the user answers it. Unbounded, one pass over the 40-entry fleet opens 40 and the installer hits Android's 50-session cap - 'Too many active sessions for UID'. The remainder is picked up by the next pass. User-initiated 'Update all' is NOT capped: it runs in the foreground where the dialog appears and sessions resolve at once.
auto_update._doc_enabled: Off because this app compiles no libs:updater: the Store updates it, as it does Cloud Calc and Cloud Search.

ui._doc: #868 THE nav declaration (libs:bottomnav NavDecl) of Hardtech-CAD: the sections on the bottom bar in order (Models | Home | Sim2Real, #1777), their sub-pages (ui.sections[].pages, drawn as the shared second row), and a hidden About behind the gear of the first row. #1335 ui.stacks[<page id, or section id for a section without pages>] is the page of that section or sub-page: a list of entries drawn by declared KIND (Pages.kt: entry, section_title, holdings, about, library, models, info, nav). An `entry` has a title, a one-line subtitle and ONE declared source for its target: `site` (the label of a link of aa_cloud-superapp/data/linktree.json), `registry` (a code of aa_cloud-superapp/build.json ui.app_urls.registry_sites) or `repo` + `path` (a repo under ui.app_urls.repo_base); app/build.gradle resolves them at BUILD time from the SuperApp's own declarations (fails if one does not resolve) and bakes UI_TARGETS_B64, so no address is typed in this file or in Kotlin. A `planned` entry has a note and no source and is drawn greyed. No price, rate or chart is declared: nothing real to show yet. #1777 `info` is a card with a title and a description (no target, not greyed), `nav` is a card that opens another section and page of this app (section + page).

sap2000.title: SAP2000
sap2000.subtitle: Structural analysis and design of frames, shells and bridges
sap2000.note: Planned: coming. No connector is shipped yet; this page describes the intended integration.

sap2000.title: Role in Sim2Real
sap2000.subtitle: Takes a structural model prepared under Models (an IFC building model or a STEP frame) and returns member forces, displacements and utilisation ratios, so a calculated result can be compared with measurements of the real structure.

sap2000.title: How the tool is reached
sap2000.subtitle: SAP2000 is driven through its published programming interface (the Open Application Programming Interface) on a Windows host that holds the licence; a fleet agent on that host would run the analysis and hand back files. No licence or solver is bundled in the app and none is needed on the phone.

sap2000.title: Inputs and outputs
sap2000.subtitle: In: geometry from IFC or STEP, sections, materials and load cases as JSON. Out: result tables as CSV and a mesh view as GLB for the 3D viewer used by Models.

sap2000.title: Open-source alternative
sap2000.subtitle: OpenSees and Code_Aster cover comparable structural analysis without a licence and would be the first targets while the commercial connector is built.

sap2000.title: Status
sap2000.subtitle: Planned. The HardTech-Stack-CAD-Simulators repository holds no connector for this tool yet; the page will switch to a live connection when one ships.

matlab.title: MATLAB
matlab.subtitle: Numerical computing and simulation
matlab.note: Planned: coming. No connector is shipped yet; this page describes the intended integration.

matlab.title: Role in Sim2Real
matlab.subtitle: Runs scripted studies on the data of a model: parameter sweeps, signal processing of measurements and comparison of a simulated curve with a recorded one.

matlab.title: How the tool is reached
matlab.subtitle: MATLAB offers an engine interface for Python and a batch mode; a fleet agent on a host with the licence would start a script with its inputs and return the figures and result files. No licence is bundled in the app and none is needed on the phone.

matlab.title: Inputs and outputs
matlab.subtitle: In: parameters and measurement files (CSV, JSON). Out: result tables, plots as images and, for geometry studies, a mesh view as GLB.

matlab.title: Open-source alternative
matlab.subtitle: GNU Octave runs most plain MATLAB scripts without a licence and would be the first target for scripts that do not need toolboxes.

matlab.title: Status
matlab.subtitle: Planned. The HardTech-Stack-CAD-Simulators repository holds no connector for this tool yet; the page will switch to a live connection when one ships.

ansys.title: Ansys
ansys.subtitle: Finite element and fluid simulation
ansys.note: Planned: coming. No connector is shipped yet; this page describes the intended integration.

ansys.title: Role in Sim2Real
ansys.subtitle: Runs finite element and flow simulations on a model brought from Models (a STEP solid) and returns stress, temperature or velocity fields for the 3D viewer, closing the loop between a design and its measured behaviour.

ansys.title: How the tool is reached
ansys.subtitle: Ansys products are scripted through the open PyAnsys Python packages, which talk to the solver over gRPC on a licensed host; a fleet agent would start the session, run the study and hand back the result files. No licence or solver is bundled in the app and none is needed on the phone.

ansys.title: Inputs and outputs
ansys.subtitle: In: STEP geometry, material and boundary-condition tables as JSON. Out: field results as VTK or GLB, and summary tables as CSV.

ansys.title: Open-source alternative
ansys.subtitle: CalculiX and Elmer (finite element) and OpenFOAM (fluid flow) are open-source solvers that would be the first targets while the commercial connector is built.

ansys.title: Status
ansys.subtitle: Planned. The HardTech-Stack-CAD-Simulators repository holds no connector for this tool yet; the page will switch to a live connection when one ships.

about.tagline: Mechanical and building models in your pocket
about.description: Hardtech-CAD is the HardTech area's CAD and simulation app, opened from the SuperApp's Cloud ▸ Lnktree row. Models holds MCAD and BIM, which show the folders of the CAD and simulators repository, its address read at build time from the fleet's declarations, and SolidWorks, planned and greyed. Home is an overview that opens every page. Sim2Real holds SAP2000, MATLAB and Ansys: planned pages that state how each simulation tool is meant to connect to the models. It exists so the area's models can be looked up on the phone, in the same shared navigation as every fleet app.
features: Home overview that opens every page
Repository address read from the fleet's declarations

guide: Open Models, then MCAD or BIM, to browse the models.
Tap a model to open it.
Home lists every page; tap a card to open it.
Sim2Real pages are planned and say what the connection will be.
about.privacy: No ads and no third-party trackers. A crash report is saved on the phone and sent only to the phone's own C3 WebServer over loopback; nothing leaves the device unless you share it. It calls no fleet service: its data stays on the phone.

perms._doc: #1360 every grant this app needs, by libs:perms catalogue id (needs), and the fleet apps that do work for it with the grants THEY must hold (helpers). The ONE declaration: generated into assets/app-perms.json (cloud-android-perms-guard.py --write), drawn by Configs > General > Perms (libs:perms AppPermsSection) with live state, Grant / Open and Grant all, asked at first run (first_run), and reported as 'Missing permission X - Grant' when an operation fails (PermsGate). perms-guard fails when code uses a gated API or another app's engine that is not declared here, or when the manifest and this list disagree.
